Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner reversed the films’ verified earliest release dates when summarizing, attributing 1962 to “My Wife’s Lodger” and 1952 to “Tiger of the Seven Seas,” despite IMDb release info showing the opposite (My Wife’s Lodger: UK October 1952; Tiger of the Seven Seas: Italy December 23, 1962). This swap led to the incorrect conclusion that Tiger of the Seven Seas was released earlier instead of the correct answer, My Wife’s Lodger.
